counts_for: P4 rounds only; R1 is judged on a later pre-registered confirmation evaluation
copied_from: ot10-quadruped-3-w2 (read-only; copied with cp -a), the copy of ot10-quadruped-3 at its accepted revision on which ot10 trained w2-1 and w2-2

spec_block.checked: built on a scratch copy of ot10-quadruped-3-w2 with goals=[command] and success=walk_spec on walk_task: accepted; the bundle carries goal command (speed, 58.02036-96.7006 mm/s, held) and all thirteen predicates W1, W2, W3, W4-lateral, W4-heading, W5-steps, W5-share, W6, W7, W8-low, W8-high, W9, W10

per_run.seed_rule: the product agent chooses it at train_start; train_start refuses any of 1101-1110
per_run.registered_by: train_start writes runs/<run>/registration.json and a train_registered ledger row before launch

wall_clock_bound: 4 turns; each run at most 2400 s; one GPU job at a time (machine training lock)
stop_rule: an evaluation passes on every seed, or 4 runs have been trained and evaluated, or 4 turns have ended
supervision: rounds.py under setsid, outliving the actor's session; each training run under its own cadex_cli.loop supervisor
mechanism: fixed for the session: the spec's HIP_MM, WEIGHT_N and SPEC_LIFT are this model's
after: after each evaluation the script's spec block is compared with retained/walk-spec-block.txt; a difference voids that evaluation
